description: Review non-compete durations exceeding the configured 12-month threshold.
rationale: Non-competes longer than 12 months are frequently challenged as unreasonable in many jurisdictions and warrant manual review.

description: Review non-compete clauses with worldwide geographical scope.
rationale: Worldwide non-competes are rarely enforceable and may be overbroad, warranting review.

description: Review customer non-solicitation durations exceeding the configured 12-month threshold.
rationale: Customer non-solicitation beyond 12 months may be considered unreasonably restrictive depending on industry and jurisdiction.

description: Review customer non-solicitation clauses with worldwide geographical scope.
rationale: Worldwide customer non-solicitation restrictions are unusually broad and may not be enforceable.

description: Review employee non-solicitation durations exceeding the configured 12-month threshold.
rationale: Employee non-solicitation beyond 12 months may restrict workforce mobility unreasonably.

description: Review employee non-solicitation clauses with worldwide geographical scope.
rationale: Worldwide employee non-solicitation is overbroad for most organizations.

description: Review confidentiality durations exceeding the configured 61-month threshold.
rationale: Confidentiality obligations beyond 5 years are uncommon outside trade-secret contexts and may impose prolonged compliance burden.

description: Flag confidentiality clauses with explicit post-termination survival obligations for review.
rationale: Post-termination confidentiality obligations extend compliance burden beyond the contract and should be reviewed for scope and reasonableness.

description: Review exclusivity durations exceeding the configured 24-month threshold.
rationale: Exclusivity arrangements beyond 2 years significantly limit business flexibility and alternative partnerships.

description: Review termination notice periods below the configured 30-day threshold.
rationale: Short notice periods may leave insufficient time for transition planning and risk assessment.

description: Flag termination clauses allowing termination for convenience or without cause.
rationale: Termination for convenience allows the other party to exit without breach, creating business continuity risk.

description: Review IP assignments with perpetual, worldwide, or irrevocable scope.
rationale: Broad IP assignment scopes permanently transfer valuable rights and should be reviewed carefully to ensure they are intentional.

description: Flag IP assignment clauses with no explicit exceptions for review.
rationale: IP assignments without exceptions may unintentionally capture prior work, personal projects, or unrelated inventions.

description: Flag indemnity clauses with no stated liability limitations.
rationale: Unlimited liability exposure means the indemnifying party could owe uncapped damages, which is a significant financial risk.

description: Flag indemnity clauses that explicitly list covered damages for review.
rationale: Explicit damage coverage lists should be reviewed to verify scope aligns with acceptable risk exposure.

description: Flag governing law clauses with a specified jurisdiction for informational review.
rationale: The specified jurisdiction determines which courts and laws apply; review to ensure it is acceptable and not in an unfavorable venue.
